recommended.title: Install, upgrade, uninstall, reinstall — tested, not assumed
recommended.acceptance: The installer's lifecycle is exercised automatically wherever that is possible on a runner, and everything that is not is named for the commander's machine. REQUIRED: clean install on a machine that has never had the application, then launch. REQUIRED: upgrade over a previous version with user data preserved, which is the one a release breaks most often and nobody tests. REQUIRED: uninstall leaves no service, no scheduled task and no orphaned node.exe, and states exactly what user data it keeps or removes. REQUIRED: reinstall after uninstall. REQUIRED: each case is marked automated or commander-machine, with the reason, so the split is visible rather than implied.

recommended.title: The automated half of the Windows matrix, running on Windows
recommended.acceptance: Every row PW-0601 marks automated runs on a windows-latest runner and fails the build when it fails. REQUIRED: the existing e2e suite runs against the DESKTOP target on Windows, not only the web target on Ubuntu -- the desktop axis is currently built on Ubuntu only, and only incidentally, because the axis defaults on and openssl happens to be installed. REQUIRED: the shell is driven end to end where the harness can reach it, and where it cannot, the row stays in the commander-machine half rather than being replaced by a unit test that proves something easier. REQUIRED: retries stay at zero, on the rule playwright.config.ts already states at length. REQUIRED: a row that is skipped says why, by name, the way the existing harness already does for the desktop and media-rig axes.
